source.title: Fun with Open Source: Blender Tutorial. A cup of tea.

freshRun.reviewResolution: Provider and schema paths completed. The model returned valid grounded editorial uncertainty, which the initial harness incorrectly treated as a generic investigation condition. No result or source was changed to obtain a positive score.

assessment.reason: The frames show a Blender modeling workflow developing a hollow cylindrical form, but still images do not establish the exact action between stages or confirm a final rendered result.
concerns: The opening frame shows an in-progress bevel operation, so the demonstration begins mid-process.
The final frame remains a wireframe/editing view, making the completed result and intended takeaway uncertain.
assessment.takeaway: This appears to demonstrate shaping and refining a hollow cylindrical mesh in Blender, including rim and base adjustments.

evidence.quote: Blender edit-mode view of a hollow cylindrical mesh with the upper rim selected during a bevel operation.
Front orthographic view showing a selected lower edge loop near the base of the cylinder.
Top-angled wireframe view showing the cylinder's interior, radial bottom topology, and concentric support loops.
Wireframe perspective view of the cylindrical model with dense vertical and horizontal edge loops.

candidates.title: Smoothing the cup’s lower edge
candidates.summary: The modeled cylindrical cup is refined by working on the lower edge, then shown as a smooth open container with a rounded base.
candidates.reason: The sequence shows editable mesh topology and a selected lower edge region before a later solid, smoothed cup result.

evidence.observation: The cup is displayed in wireframe/edit view with dense cylindrical topology and an open top.
A lower horizontal edge loop near the base is visibly selected in blue.
The object is shown in solid object mode as a smooth open cup with a rounded lower edge.

limitations: Sparse still-frame sampling can miss brief events and does not verify continuous motion or full story completeness.

Audio events such as laughter, applause and music are not classified. Available transcript provides speech context only.
At most 8 source windows and 4 candidate refinements are inspected. Provider retries may make additional network attempts.
